intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Welcome to the official website of the National Federation Empire of Furnovskyland! Here you can learn how to join our Discord and Minecraft servers, and learn about our history, culture, politics, and much more!

history.pageSubtitle: Discover the historical heritage of the Empire of Furnovskyland's Commonwealth
history.welcome: Welcome to our Empire! If you are interested, please read this overview of our history.

foundation.title: Early History and State Foundation (2018)
foundation.content: For centuries, the eastern side of the Waffellandic continent was ruled by the Waffellandic Empire. In April 2018, Furnovsky, a military leader overthrown by a distant dictatorship, gathered loyal followers across the plateau — earning the title "the one who fought with angels" along his journey. In early October 2018, he negotiated with the Waffellandic King to purchase the northern settlement of Furnokisfaludi (Furnotinyvillage). Fearing an imminent invasion, he brought his coronation forward by one day to October 31, 2018 at 3:00 PM CET, receiving the Royal Sceptre, the Golden Apple, and diamond monarchical weapons from Prince Rupitu.

expansion.title: The Young Nation and Rise of the Commonwealth (2018–2021)
expansion.content: Following several late-2018 border wars, Furnovskyland achieved a decisive breakthrough in the Snowy World War, signing the Treaty of Micaragua on January 12, 2019 to secure 99% of modern Inner-Furnovskyland. The first Parliament building opened in Stadt Des Parlaments in January 2019, the first semi-democratic election and Minecraft server launched in July 2019, and Staßenburg joined on December 1, 2019. In 2020, the main Parliament in Furn-Hauptstadt was completed and a three-way coalition victory over Little-Waffelland added West-Advena and East-Advena. After a brief three-week republic in January 2021 during imperial exams, Emperor Furnovsky proclaimed the Empire of Furnovskyland's Commonwealth and founded the Discord server on April 15, 2021. Despite the devastating June 14, 2021 server attack, the nation rebuilt, inaugurated the I. Federal Government under Prince Rupitu on July 1, 2021, and joined the League of Servers (LoS).

modernEra.title: Golden Age of Democracy and Constitutional Reforms (2022–2026)
modernEra.content: In 2022, Emperor Furnovsky served two terms as World Assembly President of the League of Servers, bringing prominent statesmen such as Migaspin Casterwill, Hafiz bin Najmuldin, Damian James Ramirez, and Softing into public life. Summer 2022 reforms established fixed governmental terms and the elected Senate, followed by open political party formation in November 2022 and the First Imperial Constitution (Law 1/2023) on March 7, 2023. Migaspin led the Government for a full year as "the father of democracy." In March 2024, Furnovskyland hosted the first LoS Discord Olympics. After competitive left-right alternations in 2024–2025 under Prime Ministers Softing, Damian Ramirez, XVDX, and Hunor, the year 2026 brought historic expansion: regional Municipal Elections in January, an elected Parliament in April, over 250 Discord members by September under Prime Minister Levi's XIII. Federal Government, and the adoption of the new Constitution of Furnovskyland on October 24, 2026 establishing the 15-seat unicameral National Assembly.

geography.title: Geography and Regions
geography.content: The Empire of Furnovskyland's Commonwealth spans a land area of 546,861 km² with a population of 54.1 million across four major territories: Inner-Furnovskyland, Portlandia, West-Advena, and East-Advena. The national capital is Furn-Hauptstadt, located on the Furnovskylandic Plateau bordering the Great Snowy Mountains and the German-Slovak Monarchy. On the Minecraft server (ujfurnvaros.aternos.me), local administration is organized into active settlements including Értilos, Égerliget, Dzsungelfalva (Jungle Village), the Olympic and Poseidon Islands, and Coastal City.

government.title: Districts, Royal Family and Nobility
government.content: Inner-Furnovskyland is divided into 36 districts and 2 border regions, with major cities split into 9 municipal zones under a 4-digit postcode system (for example, 1019 denotes District 1, chief city 01, zone 9 in central Furn-Hauptstadt). The Royal Family and line of succession consist of His Majesty Emperor Furnovsky I (reigning since October 31, 2018), Crown Prince Daniel of Furn-Hauptstadt (heir-presumptive), Prince Matthew of Furnovskyvárad (second in line), Prince Daniel "Rupitu" of Staßenburg (third in line), and Fourth Palatine Damian James Ramirez (fourth in line). Citizens who render distinguished service to the Commonwealth may be elevated by the Emperor to the six ranks of nobility: Baron, Viscount, Count, Marquess, Duke, and Archduke.

flag.title: Flag and Coat of Arms
flag.content: The national flag consists of three equal horizontal stripes of red, white, and green with a yellow circle at its center (updated in 2019 from the original 2018 orange dot). The Coat of Arms (Imperial Banner) is a pointed-base, quartered shield bearing a red raven in the first silver field, a silver ship in the second red field, a silver angel in the third red field, and a red-cowled friar in the fourth silver field, centered by a purple heart-shield with a golden lily and golden triple knot, surmounted by a closed royal crown.

politics.pageSubtitle: Constitutional order, branches of power, and current officeholders of Furnovskyland

state_structure.title: State Structure
state_structure.content: Under the Constitution of Furnovskyland (adopted on October 23, 2026 and in force since October 24, 2026), the Empire of Furnovskyland's Commonwealth is an independent, democratic parliamentary monarchy based on the separation of powers. The official languages are Hungarian, English, Slovak, and German, and the capital is Furn-Hauptstadt. Head of State and Commander-in-Chief of the Furnovskyland Defence Force is His Majesty Emperor Furnovsky I, who also presides over the Server Council. Popular sovereignty is exercised through the unicameral 15-member National Assembly (Parliament), executive power is vested in the Federal Government led by the Prime Minister, judicial and constitutional review authority rests with the Supreme Court, and local public power in the settlements is exercised by directly elected Mayors.

legislative_process.title: Legislation and Legal Instruments
legislative_process.intro: The legal system of Furnovskyland is governed by the hierarchy of norms established in the 2026 Constitution:
legislative_process.organic_law: Constitution & Constitutional Amendments: The supreme foundation of the legal system; adoption or amendment requires a two-thirds majority of all Members of the National Assembly.
legislative_process.bill: Cardinal Law (Organic Law): Regulates fundamental state institutions (citizenship, political parties, press, national assets, Server Council, Defence Force, mayors); requires a two-thirds majority of National Assembly members present.
legislative_process.act: Ordinary Law (Act / Bill): Enacted by the National Assembly by a simple majority of members present (with a quorum of more than half of all MPs).
legislative_process.decree: Decree: Issued by the Government or Prime Minister within their executive competence, or jointly by the Emperor and Prime Minister during a state of emergency (up to 7 days unless extended by the National Assembly). Mayors may also issue local mayoral decrees. No decree may conflict with a law or the Constitution.
legislative_process.act_submit: Laws may be initiated by the Emperor, the Government, a parliamentary committee, or any Member of the National Assembly, and follow three stages:
legislative_process.step1: The bill is debated and voted on in the National Assembly (which holds public sessions every second Friday at 20:00 UTC as well as continuous legislative votes). National referendums may also be initiated by 5% of voters (discretionary) or 10% of voters (mandatory).
legislative_process.step2: Before or after adoption, the bill may be referred to the Supreme Court to verify conformity with the Constitution. Once passed, the President (Speaker) of the National Assembly signs the law within 5 days and sends it to the Emperor.
legislative_process.step3: Within 5 days of receipt, the Emperor either signs and promulgates the law in the Federal Gazette, returns it once with comments to the National Assembly for reconsideration, or refers it to the Supreme Court for priority constitutional review (decided within 7 days).

senate.title: The National Assembly (Parliament) and Electoral System
senate.p1: The supreme organ of popular representation is the 15-member National Assembly, which replaced the former bicameral Parliament and 5-seat STV Senate under the October 24, 2026 Constitution. Members are elected every 4 months by universal, direct, and secret ballot in a nationwide proportional list election using the D'Hondt method. Electoral thresholds are 5% for a single party list, 10% for a two-party joint list, and 15% for a coalition of three or more parties. Key constitutional powers of the National Assembly and other elected bodies include:

affairs.internal: Enacting ordinary laws, cardinal laws (2/3 majority), the central budget, and constitutional amendments
affairs.foreign: Electing the Prime Minister (on the Emperor's proposal) and holding the Government accountable via interpellations, committees, and constructive motions of no confidence
affairs.minecraft: Electing the President of the Supreme Court (by a 2/3 majority for 6-month terms) and appointing two professional Supreme Court judges
affairs.constitutional: Authorizing international treaties (such as League of Servers treaties by a 2/3 majority) and reviewing special legal orders or states of emergency
affairs.recruitment: Local Municipal Elections held every 5 months where citizens directly elect settlement Mayors, who administer local affairs and sit on the Server Council

senate.p2: In the October–November 2026 Parliamentary Election (47 ballots cast), the Alliance for Furnovskyland (AfF) led by Prime Minister Levi won 29 votes (61.7%) and 9 seats, while the United Conservative Coalition (Christian-Conservative Party – United Furnovskyland) led by Dr. Attikasp won 18 votes (38.3%) and 6 seats.

executive.title: Executive Power
executive.description: Exercised by the Federal Government (Prime Minister, Deputy Prime Ministers, Ministers, and State Secretaries), responsible to the National Assembly.

judicial.title: Judicial Power
judicial.description: Exercised by the independent Supreme Court, serving as both constitutional court and supreme criminal, civil, and administrative court.

legislative.title: Legislative Power
legislative.description: Exercised by the 15-member National Assembly elected via D'Hondt proportional representation every 4 months.

supreme_court.title: The Supreme Court
supreme_court.content: Under Articles 22–27 of the 2026 Constitution, the Supreme Court is the integrated supreme organ for the protection of the Constitution and the administration of justice. It consists of three professional judges who must be independent, impartial, and non-partisan: the President of the Supreme Court (elected by a two-thirds majority of the National Assembly for a 6-month term on the proposal of the Emperor) and two judges appointed by the National Assembly. The Supreme Court reviews laws and mayoral decrees for constitutionality, adjudicates criminal, private-law, and administrative cases, hears appeals against border entry refusals by the Furnovskyland Defence Force, and conducts Ostracization proceedings.

join.question: How can I join Furnovskyland?
join.answer: Join our official Discord server via the invite link on the home page and complete the border screening in the verification channel. Under Article 39 of the Constitution, the Furnovskyland Defence Force reviews entry applications within 72 hours to prevent alt accounts, trolling, or security risks. Requesting private real-life personal data (real name, address, or photo) is strictly prohibited.

citizenship.question: How can I obtain citizenship and participate in politics?
citizenship.answer: Once cleared at the border, you receive the Citizen role on Discord. Citizens enjoy universal suffrage to vote and stand as candidates in the 15-member National Assembly elections (every 4 months) and regional Mayoral elections (every 5 months), vote in national referendums, apply for government or judicial offices, or found a political party with at least 2 members.

visit.question: How can I play on the Minecraft server and participate in the economy?
visit.answer: Connect to ujfurnvaros.aternos.me (Minecraft 1.21.11, supporting both Java and Bedrock as well as cracked accounts, with cross-platform Discord chat and MTVehicles). To participate in settlement administration, municipal elections, or the national Furn-Brule (Fß) currency system overseen by the National Bank of Furnovskyland, register a Roleplay (RP) profile in the Discord server.

guides.title: Political, Electoral & Emergency Guides
guides.description:
Electoral System (2026 Constitution): The 15-member National Assembly is elected every 4 months by proportional party-list voting using the D'Hondt method (5% threshold for single parties, 10% for two-party lists, 15% for coalitions of three or more). Campaigning takes place exclusively in the designated campaign channel during the 5-day campaign period; DM campaigning or soliciting votes from non-citizens is prohibited under the Decree-Law Against Voter Fraud. Settlement Mayors are elected every 5 months by First-Past-The-Post (or simple-majority confidence vote if unopposed).

Creating a Political Party: Any citizen may register a political party by opening a registration thread with the party's name, ideology, motto, optional logo, and at least 2 members (including the founder). Extremist or authoritarian parties threatening the constitutional democratic order are prohibited under Article V of the Constitution.

Nobility & State Awards: The Emperor may bestow Ministerial Crosses (Golden, Silver, Bronze) for extraordinary political or administrative service, as well as six ranks of peerage: Baron, Viscount, Count, Marquess, Duke, and Archduke.

Furnovskylandic Secret Code Protocol System (FUSCPS): Official imperial continuity codes announced in Channel 1: CODE RED N' BLACK / CODE BLACK (immediate succession of the Crown Prince), CODE RED N' WHITE (abdication and succession following final address), CODE TEMP (temporary regency), and CODE CO-TEMP (co-regency).
